title: Newton + load_stepping integration test
objective: Write integration test that wires newton_solve to adaptive_load_stepping and compares output against ref_hex8_plastic.py::solve_plastic (atol=1e-10).
implementation_steps: In test_newton.py, add integration test class/section
Build newton_solve_fn(load_factor) closure using ref_hex8_plastic assembly functions
Verify load stepping result shows convergence with appropriate step count
acceptance_criteria: newton_solve + adaptive_load_stepping produces displacement matching reference within atol=1e-10
History fields are properly committed at converged steps
verification_commands: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu' -x -q

cases: Plastic cantilever: newton_solve + load_stepping vs ref_hex8_plastic (atol=1e-10) (missing)
Load stepping converges with reasonable step count (missing)

risks: newton.py callbacks don't match reference solver patterns. Mitigation: Design callbacks to exactly match ref_hex8_plastic.py patterns. If callbacks diverge, debug by comparing intermediate values (f_int, residual) step-by-step.
